$doc: CC-SPELL-O-PHONES prototype carriers. AUTHORED BY A PERSON, NEVER GENERATED (Non-goals: 'Do not generate carriers or punchlines with an LLM. Same class of string as definitions; same standing rejection.'). Every `carrier` below is a sentence with ___ where the word goes. F2's invariant: EXACTLY ONE member of the set may be semantically legal in it. Write it, then read it back with each of the other members substituted -- if another one fits, the carrier is unwinnable and must be rewritten. A null carrier means the slot is unauthored; the prototype QUARANTINES the whole set rather than serving a partial one (F1). The ten sets are the voice-verified families from tools/spellophones-voice-check.py -- each one measured at or under the indistinguishable floor, so the audio genuinely does not give the answer away.
